attr.title: GreenOvercast
attr.desc: An unofficial Xbox Cloud Gaming and GeForce NOW client with a searchable, controller-first library for Linux handhelds.
attr.inst: Requires internet access and an Xbox cloud gaming or GeForce NOW account. Choose a service and follow the on-screen sign-in instructions.
